problem: Targeted route verification marked a desktop preview route red with failedAssets document:/ even though the page returned 200, rendered visible content, and had correct canonical identity.
root_cause: The requestfailed listener treated every same-origin document failure as a hard asset failure and discarded Playwright's failure reason, so a browser-cancelled superseded navigation (net::ERR_ABORTED) was indistinguishable from a genuine document network failure.
fix: Preserve fail-closed asset checking but classify only document net::ERR_ABORTED as benign; every other document, script and stylesheet request failure remains hard.
failed_approaches: Treating all requestfailed document events as equivalent hard network failures without inspecting failure.errorText.
prevention: Record the failure reason when classifying browser asset failures.
Ignore only document + net::ERR_ABORTED as a benign superseded navigation.
Keep all scripts, stylesheets and non-aborted document failures fail-closed.
